status: FROZEN by the freeze commit recorded in docs/worklogs/86A_WORKLOG_ECRO_SHARP_FAILURE_ATTRIBUTION.md, before the evidence run of Stages C-E
question: Does ECRO v0 fail on sharp directional interreflection because physically distinct transport conditions become indistinguishable to its runtime inputs, or because its learned response mapping fails despite sufficient input information?

frozen_baseline.preserved: ER states, checkpoints, representation (1,270 patches, 64 + 64 bins, 512 state rays, 16 source points, R 16, rank 24), splits, references, thresholds, verdicts

stage_A_B_exploration: Stage A (exact recomputation of the WL86 numbers) and Stage B (importance decomposition of the rendered error of the frozen tables) were run once on the stored WL86 data before this protocol was written; they use no new reference and motivated the hypothesis below. They are re-run unchanged in the evidence chain.
prospective_hypothesis: H_A: the deficit of the learned table at the Lambert patches read by the panel (back wall, box B) is the mislocation / spreading of the light -> panel (sharp) -> patch family, caused by the 64-bin incident-direction encoding: within one incident bin (about 0.35 rad) the specular beam of the sharp panel moves by more than a patch, and a source-linear operator that sees only the encoding must answer with one response per (patch, bin) cell.

variants.TRUE: the workload's light (validation of the diagnostic tracer against the stored WL86 oracle field)
variants.ANG_PANEL: panel patches: same irradiance, position and visibility as the light, direction redrawn uniformly inside its incident bin (isolates angular binning at the sharp sender)
variants.ANG_SPHERE: the same on the moderate sphere
variants.ANG_BROAD: the same on all broad patches (floor B and Lambert): control
variants.ENC_PANEL: panel patches lit by the re-emitted encoding (patch-average irradiance per bin, uniform direction in the bin; high-quality encoding)
variants.ENC_ALL: every patch lit by the re-emitted high-quality encoding: an incident field with the SAME encoding as the light (encoding-equivalent source); per vertex one of the 16 strongest bins of the patch is drawn in proportion to its irradiance (coverage of the encoding reported)
variants.ENC16_ALL: as ENC_ALL with the deployed 16-point encoding

beams.patches: panel centre (S1), sphere patch facing the light (S2), a floor patch (B), a back-wall patch (Lambert); chosen by rule from geometry and light position
beams.note: a beam is an incident field on its patch emitted by a virtual projector 0.25 m away (occlusion tested within that distance); half-patch pairs on planar patches only
beams.pairs: polar_a / polar_b and azim_a / azim_b: two collimated beams on the same patch with directions inside the SAME incident bin and equal E cos(theta); half_a / half_b: the same direction on the two halves of the patch with doubled E. Each pair has identical encodings by construction. other_bin: centre of the adjacent ring (scale).

measures.P: importance-weighted signed error of a table X in a region R: sum W_R . (X - B_ref) / sum tot_REF-ER, W_R = accumulated LOW-bounce throughput of the region's camera paths (exact field -> render identity, Stage B). B_ref = the stored WL86 oracle field for learned tables, the TRUE diagnostic field for diagnostic tables
measures.E_H: WL86 measure on rendered images: sum |hl_X - h_REF-ER| / sum tot_REF-ER
measures.explained_fraction: P(diagnostic table) / mean over seeds of P(learned table), per case
measures.patch_agreement: over sender patches, importance-weighted correlation and slope between the signed patch contributions of the diagnostic table and of the learned table
measures.resolved: a difference is resolved when it is at least 4 x its half-split noise

rules.validation: TRUE diagnostic field vs stored WL86 oracle field: flux ratio within 1 % and P within 4 x noise in every case; beam pairs: encodings identical (max abs difference 0); frozen operator returns identical tables for the two members of a pair
rules.counterexample: information loss is DEMONSTRATED for a (patch, bin) cell when a pair with identical encodings has path-traced responses whose relative L1 distance is >= 0.2 and >= 4 x noise
rules.source_estimator: SUPPORTED if replacing the 16-point encoding by the 1,024-point encoding in the frozen operator changes P by >= 25 % of the learned P in >= 2 of 3 primary cases; WEAKENED if < 10 % in all three; else INDETERMINATE
rules.source_angular_encoding: SUPPORTED (dominant) if the explained fraction of ENC_ALL is >= 0.5 with the same sign in >= 2 of 3 primary cases AND a sharp-sender counterexample is demonstrated; contributing if 0.2-0.5; WEAKENED if < 0.2 in all three
rules.sender_specificity: the angular loss is attributed to the sharp sender if ANG_PANEL carries >= 2/3 of ENC_ALL's P in the primary cases and ANG_BROAD and ANG_SPHERE each < 20 % of it
rules.geometry_state: WEAKENED as cause if (a) the generator inputs determine the geometry (patch tables of every surface incl. box faces; checked: reconstruction of box poses from the tables) and the state relation is implemented correctly (WL86 contracts, re-checked) and (b) STALE-vs-current evidence shows the operator uses the state; SUPPORTED only with a demonstrated identical-state / different-response pair; else INDETERMINATE
rules.learned_mapping: WEAKENED as the cause of the primary failure if the learned tables agree with the encoding-equivalent field better than with the truth at the important patches (patch_agreement correlation >= 0.7 and explained fraction >= 0.5), i.e. the operator is near what its inputs allow; SUPPORTED if the explained fraction of ENC_ALL is < 0.2 (inputs suffice, mapping fails); else contributing / INDETERMINATE
rules.supervision: reported from the frozen operator's field error by patch class on the high-quality training subset vs validation and from the target noise; classified WEAKENED for the primary failure if the same deficit pattern is predicted by ENC_ALL (noise-free construction), otherwise INDETERMINATE
rules.camera_readout: the readout is an AMPLIFIER (not a defect) if the field-level error on the sender shapes is at the oracle noise on average while the importance-weighted error is >= 4 x larger

intervention_gate.admissible: only a change that targets a SUPPORTED bounded cause inside the frozen family: source estimator defect (same bins), supervision precision (same operator), state implementation defect
intervention_gate.not_admissible: more angular bins or patches, another source encoding, larger rank, another operator class, a sharp-path solver, a new geometric representation, changed ER
intervention_gate.decision: if source_angular_encoding is SUPPORTED (dominant), the cause lies in the frozen input contract; no admissible intervention exists -> STOP at attribution with outcome ARCHITECTURE INPUT CONTRACT INADEQUATE, no retraining, no E3. If source_estimator or supervision is the supported bounded cause, an intervention contract and a held-out edit E3 are frozen in an amendment before any revised result.

verdict_mapping.OUTPUT REPRESENTABILITY: WL86 R1 (oracle projection), re-verified in Stage A
verdict_mapping.SOURCE INPUT SUFFICIENCY: NOT SUPPORTED if a counterexample is demonstrated and source_angular_encoding is SUPPORTED; SUPPORTED if no counterexample is resolved and ENC_ALL meets the WL86 region rule; else CONDITIONALLY / INDETERMINATE
verdict_mapping.LEARNED MAPPING ADEQUACY: from rule learned_mapping (scope: given its inputs)
verdict_mapping.SHARP EDIT RESPONSE: WL86 measurement (region C slope) with the attributed cause
verdict_mapping.INTERVENTION GENERALIZATION: NOT TESTED unless an intervention is admitted
verdict_mapping.ECRO v0 ARCHITECTURE VIABILITY: unchanged WL86 verdict with its cause; a diagnostic result never upgrades it
